Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
events.summary:
Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat

Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people.

Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing.

events.title: Elon Musk thanked by German far-right leader after landmark election win praised by Russia | First Thing
events.summary:
Populist, far-right, anti-immigration AfD wins vote in eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt. Plus, 50 years since The Muppet Show first hit our screens

  • Don’t already get First Thing in your inbox? Sign up here

Good morning. A far-right leader who has won an important state election in Germany has thanked Elon Musk for his support, as voices in Europe warn the result is a serious moment for the continent. No far-right party has led or formed a government in Germany since the defeat of nazism at the end of the second world war.

Ulrich Siegmund, the Alternative für Deutschland’s lead candidate, thanked Musk on X after the tech billionaire said “Well done!” in German to the AfD co-founder Alice Weidel. The populist, far-right, anti-immigration party won the vote in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt.

Will the AfD be able to form a state government? Despite its resounding victory, the party fell just short of a majority. It was seeking an absolute majority in the state legislature to govern alone and overcome the so-called “firewall” of the mainstream parties, which refuse to work with it. The final results showed the AfD falling three seats short, with 39 lawmakers in an 83-member legislature.

What has been the reaction in Washington and Moscow? Donald Trump posted a screenshot of the election projection without comment on his Truth Social site. The Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev took a screengrab of Trump’s post and praised a “historic win for the pragmatic AfD”. The AfD is pro-Kremlin, urging a stop to support for Ukraine and pushing for Ukrainians in Germany to no longer receive refugee status.

Who else has been saying Trump’s war may not achieve its aims? The US energy secretary, Chris Wright, said on Sunday morning Washington might not be able to reach an agreement with Tehran that would prevent Iran from having nuclear weapons. “We are strangling their economy to try to bring either a change in policy from the existing regime or a new regime,” he said.

events.summary: Authorities say that at least 10 people were killed and 64 injured when fireworks exploded during a religious festival in Mexico on Saturday. A bishop said two priests are among the injured. The cause remains unknown, and the state attorney general is investigating.

events.title: Search for survivors from deadly Nepal floods enters eighth day
events.summary: The search for survivors from the deadly floods in Nepal enters its eighth day as mourners have begun to hold symbolic cremations, with morgues overwhelmed by a large number of unidentified remains. The incident claimed more than 1,200 lives and left more than 4,000 missing. NBC News' Daniele Hamamdjian reports on the ongoing rescue efforts and burial ceremonies.

events.title: In Havana, church meals become a lifeline for many
events.summary: As the food shortage in Cuba worsens and some elderly residents look through the trash for their next meal, church volunteers provide what’s become some people’s only meal.

events.title: King Charles confirms Harry and Meghan will not be working royals after U.K. return
events.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan will not be working members of Britain’s royal family now they have returned to the U.K., a letter sent on behalf of King Charles said.

events.title: U.S. envoys ‘very encouraged’ after peace talks in Moscow and Kyiv
events.summary: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner said talks were “substantive,” but neither gave details of any proposal to end the conflict.

events.title: U.S. strikes 3 Iranian oil tankers after Iran targets Navy warships, military says
events.summary: U.S. Central Command said no American personnel were harmed in the Iranian missile attacks.

events.title: Serbia accused of ‘glorifying’ convicted war criminal Ratko Mladić ahead of funeral
events.summary: BELGRADE, Serbia — The European Union’s Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos on Friday canceled an upcoming visit to candidate nation Serbia over what she described as the “glorification” of former Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladić following his death.

events.title: Two trapped workers pulled alive from Nepal tunnel more than a week after deadly floods
events.summary: Two workers in Nepal were pulled out alive from a hydropower tunnel on Friday, some nine days after devastating floods swept the Himalayan region and left thousands of people missing.

events.title: Senior aides to British Trump ally Nigel Farage step down after foreign funding sting
events.summary: Britain’s populist Reform UK said two senior aides to leader Nigel Farage stepped down on Friday after an undercover investigation alleged the party had broken electoral law by arranging for a foreign donor to pay for political polling.

events.title: In Nepal, mourners hold symbolic cremation for missing loved ones
events.summary: As hopes for those still missing fade, families without the remains of their relatives are burning effigies on miniature funeral pyres.

events.title: Iran targets American bases after U.S. strikes sites near Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: The strikes were in “retaliation for the Iranians’ failed attempt at adding sea mines” in the Strait of Hormuz, Trump said on Truth Social.

events.title: Nepal flood deaths pass 1,100 as hope fades in the search for survivors
events.summary: The overwhelming stench of death is crushing hopes that more survivors will be found in this Nepali town devastated by last week’s catastrophic floods.

events.title: Thousands of U.S. service members arrive in Thailand after record stint at sea
events.summary: About 5,000 U.S. sailors and Marines are stopping in the resort city of Pattaya for a “rest and relaxation” break as they return home from a record-setting deployment in the Middle East.

events.title: Allies bristle as sanctioned Russian finance minister attends U.S.-hosted G20 summit
events.summary: Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov was left out of the “family photo” of finance ministers at a G20 meeting after complaints from Ukraine’s allies.

events.title: Record baby boom brings world’s heaviest parrot back from the brink
events.summary: A record 90 chicks have been added to the population count of the kakapo parrot in New Zealand, delighting conservationists.
